enterpriseId.description: The unique ID of the enterprise.

SubStatus.description: The sub-status of the enterprise. This parameter is will be returned only if the enterprise is NPA and delinquency.

programeID.description: The ID of the program associated with the enterprise.

programSubscriptionDate.description: The date when the enterprise subscribed to the program.

delinquencyCycle.description: The number of days the enterprise has been in delinquency.

maxcreditLimit.description: The maximum credit limit for the enterprise.

creditLimit.description: The credit limit for the enterprise.

availableCreditLimit.description: The available credit limit for the enterprise.

allocatedCreditLimit.description: The allocated credit limit for the enterprise.

unallocatedCreditLimit.description: The unallocated credit limit for the enterprise.

outstandingAmount.description: The total outstanding amount of the enterprise.

cashAdvanceLimit.description: The cash advance limit of the enterprise.

availableCashAdvanceLimit.description: The available cash advance limit of the enterprise.

unbilledCreditAmount.description: The unbilled credit amount of the enterprise.

outstandingAuthorisationAmount.description: The outstanding authorisation amount of the enterprise.

minimumAmountDue.description: The minimum amount due of the enterprise.

totalAmountDue.description: The total amount due of the enterprise.

overdueAmount.description: The overdue amount of the enterprise.

dueDate.description: The due date for the enterprise.

currentStatementStartDate.description: The start date of the current statement of the enterprise.

currentStatementEndDate.description: The end date of the current statement of the enterprise.

status.description: The status of the auto debit.

type.description: The type of the auto debit.
